# Buy less stock. Cut with a plan.

> Free cut list optimizer for woodworkers and sign shops. Lay out plywood, MDF, or acrylic, compare 4×8 vs 5×5 sheets, and rank 8 ft vs 10 ft vs 12 ft boards before you buy. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cut-list-optimizer/)
- [4×8 vs 5×5: buy the size that costs less, not the one that sounds cheaper.](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cut-list-optimizer/compare-4x8-vs-5x5.html)
- [This cut list optimizer vs. optiCutter and CutList Optimizer](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cut-list-optimizer/vs-opticutter-and-cutlist-optimizer.html)
- [Cut list optimizer vs. planning cuts by hand](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cut-list-optimizer/vs-planning-cuts-by-hand.html)
